## Feature summary

Provide a clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like.

## Problem or motivation

What problem would this feature solve? Describe the situation in which you need it.

Example: I often need to ..., but currently ...

## Proposed solution

Describe how you would like the feature to work.

## Example workflow

1. Open MagicHat
2. Go to ...
3. Select ...
4. MagicHat should ...

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have tried.

## Who would benefit?

Explain which users or workflows would benefit from this feature.

## Additional context

Add any screenshots, mockups, examples, or related links that may help explain the request.

Before posting, remove passwords, access tokens, personal information, private file contents, and other sensitive data.

## Checklist

- [ ] I am using the latest version of MagicHat
- [ ] I searched existing issues and discussions for similar requests
- [ ] This request describes one feature or improvement
- [ ] I explained the problem this feature would solve
- [ ] I removed sensitive information from all submitted content
